title: Correct angle value
description: Essential: The response must state that the angle between initial velocity and positive x-axis is 45°.

title: Correct potential difference
description: Essential: The response must give the potential difference U_PQ as -mgL/q.

title: Correct time in first quadrant
description: Essential: The response must state the time in the first quadrant as √2 v₀/g.

title: Force balance in second quadrant
description: Important: The solution must recognize that uniform motion in the second quadrant requires qE = mg.

title: Net force in first quadrant
description: Important: The solution must correctly compute the net force magnitude as √2 mg in the first quadrant.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: The solution must apply work-energy theorem or equivalent to relate electric work and gravitational work from P to Q.

title: Symmetry recognition
description: Optional: The solution may note the symmetry of motion about the y-axis to determine round-trip time.

title: Sign error in potential
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the sign of U_PQ is incorrect (should be negative for negative charge moving against field).

title: Angle miscalculation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if tanθ is set incorrectly or if θ is not derived as 45° from qE = mg.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Penalize if units are missing or inconsistent in final answers (especially for U_PQ).
